reviews.title: Great Concept, but Serious Limitations for Detailed Projects
reviews.text:
I really wanted to like VideoGPT because the concept is excellent, but my experience exposed some serious limitations.

I was trying to create a video from a carefully written dialogue containing specific business facts, financial information, accomplishments, and personal context. Instead of reliably preserving the supplied material, the generation process repeatedly shortened, reworded, generalized, or dropped important information.

The input limitations made this especially frustrating. When you are trying to produce something factual rather than a generic entertainment video, every sentence can matter. I spent considerable time shortening and restructuring my material just to get it accepted, only to still have important details altered or removed during generation.

The biggest problem for me is control. If I provide specific dialogue, I need an option that means: use this dialogue exactly as written. Don’t summarize it. Don’t creatively reinterpret the facts. Don’t replace important information with generic motivational dialogue. Let me decide what gets removed.

The underlying idea is genuinely useful, and I can see why people enjoy the app for quick AI-generated videos. But for detailed projects where accuracy and precise dialogue matter, I found the current workflow too restrictive and unpredictable.

reviews.title: Emailed me asking for personal information
reviews.text:
The app asks you for a review before you’ve even had a chance to use it, which feels completely disingenuous. You should at least be able to experience the product before being asked to rate it.

The free trial offers very limited features, which makes it pointless. Before committing to a purchase, users should be able to test all features—even if only for a short time. I also received an email asking for my personal information in exchange for access to supposedly more “powerful” features. I found this quite insulting, especially considering the features I did try were not impressive at all.

The image generator produces low-resolution results, often blurry, and struggles with clear facial structure. The AI features overall are mediocre at best. What I did like is the character consistency option but this is not a stand out option and long lengths for videos but that’s it. What I saw wasn’t good enough to even pay a penny. I cancelled my free subscription in under an hour.

If I’m going to pay for something, I need to know that it what it is capable of and that it actually works. In this competitive AI Market people actually want to know what they’re paying for. Improve your features, allow people to fully test the app, and stop asking for reviews before users have even experienced the product.
